headline.text: L1 Sollich 4 lost *3 hours* to kitchen pressure alarm before clearing at 18:01 — L3 ML4 mold jam damaged equipment but maintenance cleared by mid-morning.

per_plant_summary.L1: Sollich 4 kitchen pressure alarm kept the line down from 14:25 to 18:01 — team found caramel buildup in lines causing the fault, cleared and resumed. Sollich 3 completed overnight cleaning and is waiting on temper as of 07:16. Sollich 2 ran through bad film rolls before changeover, no further impact.
per_plant_summary.L2: ML3 and FFS ran clean. FFS had a brief seal bar adjustment at 04:04 that cleared open bag issue. All three lines tracking to daily targets.
per_plant_summary.L3: ML4 mold jam at 04:53 caused by molds hitting guard rail — maintenance fixed rail, pulled 20 molds to inspect for debris. Truffle line lost 90 minutes to enrober reheat overnight but back up by 00:45. ML4 still has wrap residue on TG4, broken part on TG5, and gondola cleaning incomplete from 3rd shift.

notes.text: New Hershey caramel weight spec went live — target down to 11.5g from 12.5g, team reporting better wrapper performance on S4.
Culligan delivered water rack change-out as scheduled.
Chocolate inventory mismatch (item 10278 vs 10310) discovered during Unreal push — team proceeding with current labels, cycle count deferred until after trial.

resolved.title: Sollich 4 kitchen pressure alarm blocking caramel flow
resolved.summary: High pressure alarm triggered at 14:25 when trying to send caramel to conbar — team found caramel buildup on pipe walls and burnt caramel restricting flow.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 18:01 — team drained buffer tank to barrel, flushed lines, caramel flowing normally. Dakota confirmed "S4 is sending caramel" (William Beattie, Caleb York).

resolved.title: Sollich 4 Theegarten height rail misadjusted causing equipment damage
resolved.summary: Height rail adjusted yesterday allowing oversized pieces into wrapper, damaged fold fingers and knife film guide on three stations.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 11:53 — Chris Jeffs repaired damaged stations, all rails returned to paint line positions, centerlines updated. Nathan Topham confirmed "everything returned to proper position" and ran test section successfully.

resolved.title: Sollich 4 caramel valve seal YS140/23 leaking
resolved.summary: Valve seal leaking caramel during production run, maintenance called on-site.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 15:38 — Caleb York replaced gasket, valve sealed properly.

resolved.title: Sollich 2 film rolls 40338 v2 breaking continuously
resolved.summary: Film breaking repeatedly during SRS run, QA placing rolls on hold for quality issue.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 13:59 — Victor Romero confirmed "finished running the film, finished SRS, making changeover to BUC."

resolved.title: Sollich 3 VFD failure on C1 belt
resolved.summary: Line paused at shift start for maintenance to replace failed VFD on cooling belt 1 motor.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 16:11 — VFD replaced, William Beattie confirmed "line is running again."

resolved.title: FFS long seal bar out of adjustment causing open bags
resolved.summary: Line down at 03:55 with high open bag rate, seal bar misaligned.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 04:04 — maintenance adjusted long seal bar, VFFS running well per operator message.

resolved.title: FFS weight loss bags due to dirty knife
resolved.summary: High volume of underweight bags flagged at 07:02, knife buildup suspected.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 07:08 — knife cleaned, VFFS confirmed "the line is running."

resolved.title: ML4 mold jam damaging equipment and molds
resolved.summary: Molds hitting black guard rail at 04:53, damaging molds and scattering debris across demolding area.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 05:28 — Kimberly Morales confirmed maintenance fixed guard rail, team removed 20 molds for debris inspection and cleaned demolding area.

resolved.title: Truffle line enrober out of temper
resolved.summary: Enrober problem at 22:08 required full reheat cycle, cross conveyor slitter had no tension.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 00:45 — enrober completed reheat and tempering by 23:35, truffle line restarted production.

resolved.title: Truffle line chocolate misalignment causing accumulation
resolved.summary: Chocolate pieces not aligning properly at 01:31, maintenance called to adjust conveyor.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 01:38 — maintenance corrected alignment, centerline posted.

resolved.title: Truffle line down passing 3rd shift accumulation
resolved.summary: Line down since 05:30 to clear product buildup handed off from overnight, operator restarting kitchen.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 06:34 — Itzel confirmed line started depositing again.

needs_attention.title: Sollich 3 waiting on chocolate temper to start production
needs_attention.summary: Line ready to run after overnight cleaning and decorator install at 05:55, bed loaded at 06:22, but still waiting on temper at window close.
needs_attention.status: Nathan Topham at 07:16 said "currently waiting on temper" and will get pieces before enrober once ready.

needs_attention.title: ML4 Level 3 gondola and cross-conveyor cleaning incomplete
needs_attention.summary: Allergen cleaning for gondola and cross-conveyor gondola not completed by 3rd shift due to visible soiling, allergen swab cannot proceed.
needs_attention.status: Janeth at 02:59 posted photos and updated schedule showing task still pending, no resolution posted.

needs_attention.title: MFM missing quarter pallet trays for assorted run
needs_attention.summary: No trays available for Matrix MFM quarter pallets, showing in transit from Spring Valley in transfer truck.
needs_attention.status: Itzel at 06:28 said all trays in transfer truck, Mayra Ortega checking, no ETA posted.

needs_attention.title: ML4 TG4 has wrap residue after cleaning
needs_attention.summary: Transfer gear 4 marked completed by 2nd shift but Itzel found wrap residue still present at 12:13.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance notified at 12:13, no follow-up posted on completion of re-clean.

needs_attention.title: ML4 TG5 broken part needs replacement
needs_attention.summary: Broken component found on transfer gear 5 during inspection, maintenance and Kimberly tagged.
needs_attention.status: Photo posted at 13:25, maintenance tagged (Nelson Cook, Kimberly Morales, Alan Greer), no update on part availability or install.

needs_attention.title: ML1 mixed display carton versions on floor
needs_attention.summary: Line received with mixed display versions, QA notified, ops trying to separate versions manually.
needs_attention.status: Imperial at 06:38 reported issue, no follow-up on how many affected or resolution plan.

needs_attention.title: ML1 pre-piece weight out of range at startup
needs_attention.summary: Pre-treatment weight check failing at 06:39, outside acceptable range.
needs_attention.status: Imperial posted at 06:39, no follow-up in window on whether adjustments brought it back in range.
